items.name: use-yuva-discussions
items.title: Yuva discussions hooks
items.description: A React provider and hooks over the useyuva headless client: discussions of a page, one thread, reader sign-in, the channel's discussion mode and page ratings. Labels with English defaults.

items.name: yuva-discussion-composer
items.title: Yuva discussion composer
items.description: A Markdown composer with Write and Preview tabs for new discussions, replies and edits, and the reader sign-in prompt.

items.name: yuva-discussion-list
items.title: Yuva discussion list
items.description: The discussions of a page with New, Top and Unanswered tabs, answered and locked badges, votes and reply counts.

items.name: yuva-discussion-thread
items.title: Yuva discussion thread
items.description: One discussion: the opening post, the accepted answer, replies one level deep, votes, follow, accept, edit and delete, and the reply composer.

items.name: yuva-discussions
items.title: Yuva discussions
items.description: Discussions for a documentation page, like GitHub Discussions: the list with sort tabs, threads, accepted answers, replies, votes, a composer with preview, reader sign-in and follow.

items.name: yuva-page-feedback
items.title: Yuva page feedback
items.description: "Was this page helpful?" with yes and no, sent to Yuva as a page rating.
